summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getUTCDate in its own file, following the five spec steps. It gets the this value's time value through date::this_time_value(agent, this)? (expected to perform RequireInternalSlot), returns NaN when tv is NaN, and otherwise returns Value::Number(date::date_from_time(tv)). The ? propagation is kept, there are no branches on particular inputs, and no errors are swallowed. The only other edits are renaming the unused args/new_target parameters to underscore-prefixed names and removing the placeholder `let _ = ...` line. The gate shows build and clippy passing, 8 new test262 passes and no regressions. I could not open crate::support::date to confirm that this_time_value performs the RequireInternalSlot brand check and that date_from_time implements the full DateFromTime algorithm. The gate's 8 new passes suggest both are real, so I did not flag them.
